android.desc:
FLauncher is an open-source alternative launcher for Android TV, built with Flutter. The project is still at an early development stage and may be unstable.

Main features:
- No ads
- Customizable categories
- Manually reorder apps within categories
- Wallpaper support
- Open Android Settings
- Open 'App info'
- Uninstall app
- Clock

Source code available at https://gitlab.com/etienn01/flauncher

quotes.story_title: RootMyTV is a user-friendly exploit for rooting/jailbreaking LG webOS smart TVs

quotes.text:
It takes a bit of work, but you can replace the default Android TV launcher with an ad-free launcher, such as the free and open source FLauncher:

- Instructions for changing the default launcher on Android TV: https://www.reddit.com/r/ShieldAndroidTV/comments/o96npc/instructions_for_replacing_android_tv_home_with_a/

- FLauncher: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=me.efesser.flauncher

- Source: https://gitlab.com/flauncher/flauncher

This should work on any Android TV device.
quotes.story_title: The downfall of smart TVs: From promises of seamless viewing to ad tool

quotes.text:
Highly recommend installing FLauncher[1] as an alternative to Google's ad-filled TV home screen. Just a nice simple icon grid.

[1] https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=me.efesser.flauncher&hl=en_US&gl=US
quotes.story_title: After luring customers with low prices, Amazon stuffs Fire TVs with ads

quotes.text:
Last year, the NVIDIA Shield TV, a $200 device if you get the Pro version, received an update to Android TV that forced a new UI for the homescreen that injects ads from a variety of premium streaming services [1]. There is no easy way to disable it as far as I know other than installing a custom launcher such as FLauncher [2]. The cancers of modern day advertising cannot be understated.

[1]: https://www.guru3d.com/news-story/nvidia-shield-tv-update-annoys-users-with-ads-and-bloatware.html
[2]: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=me.efesser.flauncher
